Hand-edits are overwritten; the rulings live in kin_rulings.json. `proposals` carries only the rows a person has to answer — the ones where the other party is somebody the town holds. Statements whose other party is nobody in this dataset are counted and not listed: they are the corpus talking about the world outside the town.

not_read.the_1840_census_households: The densest kinship the corpus holds, and its crosswalk is 235 named heads stale on dev (T-0714) and derived against 849 residents where the town now holds 1,404 (T-0698). Kin read off it would land on the wrong people. Deliberately out of this pass.
